scoring_justification: DFT energies depend on pseudopotentials/functional; exact numerical match is infeasible. Scoring by verifying sign convention and qualitative trends (ordering between defect/dopant configurations) as reported in the paper.

hidden_assets.purpose: trend rules derived from paper's reported DFT results
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's description of observed trends
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the trends reported in the paper; they are used to check the agent's reproduced results and no fabricated labels are involved.

outputs.description: The checker verifies that the formation energies exhibit internally consistent and physically plausible behavior across the different configurations.
The checker verifies that the adsorption energies exhibit internally consistent and physically plausible behavior across the different configurations.

output_contract.notes: Absolute formation/adsorption energies may differ from the original paper due to use of a different DFT code (Quantum ESPRESSO vs. VASP) and pseudopotentials; only the relative trends are scored.

steps.description: Verify oxygen vacancy formation energies: positive values, trend Mn vacancy lowers E_form, surface Li series non-monotonic and defect surface lower than perfect.
Verify adsorption energies: negative values, O3 binding enhancement on V_O, weakening with V_Mn, restoration with Li, and weaker H2O/O2 binding.
